description: Draft v3 hybrid L0 overview. Keeps aggregate answer-first triage for the selected workflow/pipeline/run_type scope, adds explicit scope/provenance/first-action header semantics, and exposes a control-plane-backed run_id selector without reintroducing run_id into Prometheus labels.

options.content: 0. Control Plane1. Overview v32. Runtime3. Provider Health4. Data Quality5. WorkflowSilver Reject ExplorerExplore LogsExplore Traces

panels.title: Navigation
panels.description: Top navigation bus for the dashboard suite. Uses same-tab handoffs, preserves the current time range for dashboard-to-dashboard links, resets unsupported dashboard-specific scope where needed, and exposes Explore Logs plus an Explore Traces adjunct. Explore Traces is available only for traced runs and requires the optional tracing profile. This draft v3 surface remains aggregate-first and does not leak future execution selectors into the navigation model.

links.title: 3. Provider Health
links.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. Scope reset: provider=unknown.

links.title: 4. Data Quality
links.tooltip: Open the Data Quality dashboard in the same tab.

links.title: 5. Workflow
links.tooltip: Context mapping: workflow=$workflow. Workflow dashboard still owns its own evidence-only status filters.

links.title: Silver Reject Explorer
links.tooltip: Cross-scope handoff: bounded pipeline/run_type explorer scope. Reset scope: Silver Reject Explorer owns its own record-level filters. Opens in the same tab.

links.title: Explore Logs
links.tooltip: Requires optional tracing profile. Opens Logs Drilldown in the same tab with safe {job="bioetl"} baseline. Zero lines can legitimately mean Loki shipping is disabled, no BioETL log streams were shipped in range, or the baseline query still needs refinement inside Explore.

links.title: Explore Traces
links.tooltip: Available only for traced runs. Enable tracing with --tracing or BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__TRACING_ENABLED=true. Opens Traces Drilldown in the same tab with bounded pipeline/run_type TraceQL scope. NoOpTracing or tracing-off runs can legitimately be empty, so treat this as adjunct evidence rather than first-screen proof.

options.content: What is broken or degraded right now, and where should the operator drill down first?

panels.description: L0 v3 scope/provenance banner. Primary question: what is broken now and where should the operator drill down first? Scope: workflow=$workflow, pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, run_id=$run_id, selected Grafana time range. Provenance: shipped Prometheus current-status recording rules plus selected-range evidence. Known limitation: first-screen PromQL remains pipeline/run_type-scoped; workflow is context/evidence-first, and run_id is resolved from persisted control-plane manifests for dashboard handoff rather than exact PromQL intersection.
panels.title: Provenance
Status
panels.description: Current L0 operator state for Overview v3. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). CRIT means runtime, DQ, control-plane, workflow, or gold signals are failing for the selected pipeline/run_type. WARN means non-fatal DQ, provider, or pending-gold conditions. UNKNOWN means the dashboard cannot prove current health for the selected scope.

panels.description: Action route projection for the selected pipeline/run_type. If the panel resolves to `NO_ROUTE`, validate that `bioetl_overview_pipeline_run_type_universe` exists for the selected pipeline/run_type combination. The row exposes `action_target`, `action_reason`, and `action_dashboard_uid`; Runtime > Control Plane > Gold Lifecycle > DQ > Provider > Workflow > Monitor. Use the panel link whose title matches the routed target. Provider route fail-closes to `provider=unknown` while preserving `pipeline_context`; workflow handoff resets scope because the workflow dashboard does not accept pipeline/run_type variables.

Rows are shown in the canonical operator order: Control Plane, Runtime, Provider, Data Quality, Data Validation, Workflow. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). panels.title: Provider
panels.description: GLOBAL provider scope across pipelines. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). This panel intentionally ignores selected pipeline/run_type filters. Open Provider Health fail-closes to provider=unknown and preserves pipeline_context for return navigation.

panels.title: Workflow
panels.description: Compact GLOBAL workflow scope across pipelines, excluding the synthetic `test_pipe` surface from the first-screen overview. Each row keeps the worst current workflow status per pipeline so the first-screen table stays readable without scroll. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Current workflow status is driven by the latest bounded terminal workflow signal, not by cumulative workflow-run counters.

panels.title: Runtime Blockers Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of runtime blocker status. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Click on Runtime for detailed blocker conditions.

panels.title: DQ Status Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of DQ status. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Click on Data Quality for detailed DQ conditions.

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of gold lifecycle status. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Disabled Gold stage returns OK as a valid non-error state.

panels.title: Historical Failures
panels.description: Historical evidence only. Keeps `pipeline` and `run_type` labels from the active Grafana window.

panels.title: Recent Terminal Runs
panels.description: Historical terminal-run evidence only. Shows non-success terminal statuses grouped by pipeline so the evidence table stays readable without scroll while preserving the active Grafana time window.

panels.title: Silver Rejects + Rate
panels.description: Selected-range Silver filter reject count and ratio against Bronze records. Evidence only; current DQ incident state lives in Data Quality.
Operator note for raw metric starting points and cross-dashboard diagnostics handoffs; no datasource query is expected.
panels.title: Diagnostics Navigation

options.content:
Raw metric starting points for this dashboard are
System Status: bioetl_l0_status{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Next Action: bioetl_l0_next_action_route{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Input Status: bioetl_l0_input_status_selected{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"}.
Exact blocker reasons live in the Control Plane, Runtime, Data Quality, Provider Health, and Workflow dashboards.
Historical evidence stays in the row above.

panels.title: ID
panels.description: Identity table for the current control-plane scope. It resolves manifest_id and run_id from the local run-manifest catalog, treats Run Type = All as an unbounded run_type filter, prefers the selected run_id when present, and otherwise falls back to the latest persisted manifest only for a concrete pipeline scope. Aggregate Pipeline = All scope requires an exact run_id before this panel claims one manifest identity.

panels.title: Processed Records
panels.description: Selected-range processed-records summary for the current pipeline/run_type scope.
